_about: THE DEV TRUST SET: disposable planes only (S-5). Fixed into the dev-channel artifact at build time; a production-channel artifact
never contains it and refuses a signature by this key by name.
Its private key is derived from a PUBLISHED seed (scripts/factory-build/release-manifest.mjs, DEV_SEED_TEXT), on purpose: anyone -
the implementer, the verifier rehearsing R-1 - can sign a dev release on a disposable plane, and that is safe exactly because no
production-channel artifact trusts it. It is never a trust root on the live plane.
